jobs.description:
Requisition ID # 175766
  
  
**Job Category:** Information Technology
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Customer & Corporate Affairs
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Department Overview
  
  
The CX Strategy & Transformation team turns customer obsession into exceptional experiences. We do this through end-to-end journey management, AI-enhanced insights, technology enablement, and disciplined value delivery. We listen to customers, define the experiences we aim to deliver, and manage them across the full customer journey. We also strengthen the processes behind them and align technology investments to customer needs. As advocates for our customers, we build empathy across the company and turn insights into action that shapes strategy. Data and analytics are at the heart of this work. They are how we understand customers, find opportunities, and measure our impact.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced, full-time Data Analyst to own high impact customer analytics initiatives from start to finish. In this role, you will be a trusted partner to business stakeholders. You will dig into their challenges and design tailored solutions, from customer profiling and segmentation to targeted list generation, and in-depth campaign effectiveness analysis. Your insights will directly shape business decisions and improve the experience of the customers we serve.
  
  
You will thrive here if you enjoy working with both technical and non-technical colleagues to solve complex data challenges. You will also enjoy turning complex findings into clear, compelling stories for cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  
  
This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business needs or company requirements.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Become a trusted, go-to partner to business stakeholders. You will learn their challenges and core needs and guide them toward best data driven solutions. Own campaign analytics from start to finish. You will define target audiences, build customer lists, set success metrics, design post-campaign analyses, and deliver clear, visual reports that shape strategy and drive action. Present insights directly to senior leadership through executive-level summaries. Bring together data from multiple sources to answer high-priority business questions. Deliver ad hoc analyses, statistics, lists, and visualizations for analytics teams, Customer Research, Marketing, project managers, and other partners. Build automated data pipelines that streamline reporting and data delivery. Become an expert in customer data. That includes demographics, billing, and a wide range of structured and unstructured sources. Create intuitive, easy-to-use visual tools that put insights in the hands of business users. Work with domain experts to learn the customer programs, services, and service channels behind the data. Document data sources, methods, and processes so your work is transparent and repeatable.
  
  
Qualifications
  
**Minimum:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field or equivalent work experience 6+ years of professional experience in data analysis or a related field
  
  
**Desired:** Master's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience 1+ years of experience in customer data & analytics Strong proficiency in SQL and experience working with relational databases Proven ability to integrate, manage, and analyze data from multiple sources to meet business objectives Experience with SAS Enterprise Guide, Power BI, Teradata, and Oracle Experience with campaign management platforms such as Unica Familiarity with machine learning Ability to turn complex information into clear insights that drive decisions and action Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical details and insights clearly to colleagues and stakeholders
  
  
Compensation
  
  
PG&E provides the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed between the entry point and the middle of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.​ This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. ------------------

Our electrical design toolchain covers PCB design tools, signal/power-integrity and RF analysis tools, an ECAD data-management server, a component and design-data sync into PLM, and an internally built integration platform that is replacing a legacy ECAD-to-PLM gateway. This role keeps that toolchain running day to day, fixes it when data goes wrong, and builds the automation and add-ins that remove manual work for hardware engineers.

We hire for fundamentals and train on our systems. If you can script, know at least one ECAD tool well as a user, and like tracing a problem from symptom to root cause, we will teach you the rest.

jobs.title: Frontend CAD Flow Engineer, SI Hardware
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

The Tesla SI Hardware team is at the forefront of revolutionizing artificial intelligence through cutting-edge hardware innovation. The team designs and develops advanced AI inference and training chips that power the neural networks behind Full Self-Driving (FSD) and Tesla's humanoid robot, Optimus. By creating custom silicon and optimized architectures, the team keeps Tesla at the leading edge of computational efficiency and performance.

Our SI Hardware CAD team builds and maintains the end-to-end infrastructure that takes complex SoC and 3D IC designs from RTL to tapeout. As a Staff CAD Flow Engineer focused on the front end, you will build the flows that RTL and physical design engineers rely on every day: constraints, synthesis, equivalence, static RTL checks, power intent, and the handoff system that ties them together. Building these well takes real technical depth. You will bring each flow up on real blocks, analyze the results until you understand exactly why the tools report what they do, and turn that understanding into a system that gives designers correct, actionable answers. You are not the one fixing every CDC violation, but you understand them well enough to build the flow that helps every designer find and fix their own.

 **What You'll Do**

* Architect and build the RTL-to-PD handoff system: automated quality gates for elaboration, lint, CDC/RDC, SDC, UPF, smoke synthesis, and LEC. Give RTL and PD engineers clear pass/fail criteria they trust
* Build the timing constraint (SDC) flow: constraint linting, block-vs-top and RTL-vs-netlist consistency checks, and templates or generators for common clocking and I/O structures. Produce reports that point designers to the root cause instead of encouraging more exceptions
* Maintain the front-end build: file list and compile-spec generation, IP and library collateral management, and automated quality checks on internal and third-party IP deliveries
* Build and maintain synthesis flows (Genus, Fusion Compiler, or Design Compiler): library and dont\_use setup, hierarchy strategy, clock gating, DFT hooks, and QoR reporting, with correlation to post-route results
* Build lint, CDC, and RDC infrastructure (SpyGlass, Jasper, Questa, or equivalent): rule sets, constraint and waiver methodology, and sign-off criteria. Tune them on real designs to separate real issues from noise
* Build formal equivalence flows (Conformal LEC or Formality) from RTL through netlist and ECO. Automate setup, mapping, and first-pass triage of non-equivalence and aborts, including low-power-aware LEC
* Develop RTL power-intent flows: UPF guidelines and checks for RTL owners, low-power static checks (VC LP / Conformal LP) at RTL and netlist, and consistency with the implementation UPF
* Build automated detection and reporting of common RTL and synthesis issues so designers catch them before handoff: unintended latches, logic optimized away, undriven or multi-driven nets, black boxes, and unexpected area or power
* Bring up early RTL-level power and area estimation (e.g., Joules, PowerArtist) so designers see PPA impact during development
* Pilot every flow on real blocks and reference designs. Do the deep technical analysis needed to validate results, and iterate with RTL and PD engineers until the flow is right

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Typically 8+ years in front-end CAD, design methodology, synthesis, or RTL design for complex SoCs at advanced process nodes
* A track record of building front-end flows or tools that other engineers adopted and relied on through tapeout
* Deep technical understanding of the problems those flows solve, enough to build checks that are correct and to explain any result to a designer
* Hands-on experience running these flows on real designs and digging into the results: debugging constraint problems, synthesis QoR, and LEC failures yourself
* Hands-on experience with Genus, Fusion Compiler, or Design Compiler; Conformal LEC or Formality; and lint/CDC/RDC tools
* Working knowledge of UPF, low-power static checks, and how RTL power intent carries into implementation
* Strong Python and Tcl, plus software engineering habits: version control, testing, CI, and config-driven design that others can extend
* Ability to work independently on a small team: understand what designers need, take an ambiguous problem to a deployed solution, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to RTL and PD engineers

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction

jobs.description:
POSITION: Laboratory Technician

**Reports to:** Laboratory Director

**Location:** Carlsbad Desalination Plant (CDP)

**Starting Hourly Rate:** $28.00-$30.00/hour

**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

A world leader in water treatment solutions, IDE specializes in the development, engineering, construction and operation of desalination, water reuse, and industrial water treatment plants.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION:**

Under the general supervision and direction of the Laboratory Director, this position performs microbiological and chemical water quality analyses required for NPDES permit compliance, plant operations, environmental monitoring, and Division of Drinking Water (DDW) requirements. Performs quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) tasks in conformance with the Environmental Laboratory Accreditation Program (ELAP) standards set for in the California Code of Regulations; and performs other related duties as assigned.

This is an entry-level position within a specialized laboratory operating in the complex, technically demanding environment of a large-scale seawater desalination facility.

The position plays a critical role in protecting public health by generating accurate, defensible analytical data used to monitor treatment performance, verify regulatory compliance, and optimize plant operations.

**ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:**

* Collect raw seawater, process stream, and finished drinking water samples on daily basis.

* Conduct field measurements.

* Maintains, calibrates, and repairs laboratory and sampling equipment.

* Co-ordinates lab equipment maintenance as needed.

* Performs data entry and validation into the Laboratory Information System (LIMS).

* Participates in upholding the laboratory quality management system.

* Calibrates and maintains instruments.

* Performs various laboratory analyses in accordance with the Environmental Laboratory Accreditation Program (ELAP) and Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater. Analyses include but are not limited to: (a) discharge and source water analyses required for compliance with the Carlsbad Desalination Plant’s NPDES permit; (b) source, process, and final product water for compliance with the DDW Permit. Generally, these analyses include: total coliform and e. coli, pH, turbidity, total suspended solids, settleable solids, conductivity, temperature, total chlorine residual, alkalinity, total dissolved solids, calcium, and fluoride.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

**Specific Types of Knowledge, Skills and Physical Abilities Required for These Duties:**

· Knowledge of physical, chemical, and biological test procedures.

· Ability to read, interpret, and consistently follow established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and laboratory quality system requirement when performing sampling, analysis, and equipment maintenance.

· Knowledge of personal hygiene and safety practices required when working with potentially contagious, corrosive, and/or toxic materials.

**Position overview:**

SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is seeking a research associate in the Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) to develop new approaches to low-dose imaging that exploit correlations between photons. The candidate will build Monte Carlo models of imaging systems, design and commission a prototype in a SLAC laboratory, and compare measured images with simulation to quantify the achievable reduction in dose. The project brings together scientists across LCLS, SSRL and SLAC's detector groups with external university partners, and is closely linked to a DOE X-ray quantum imaging program. The candidate is expected to have core interests in quantum or correlated imaging, physics simulations and experimental setup.

### **Job Overview**

**Position overview:**

SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory is seeking a research associate in the Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) to develop new approaches to low-dose imaging that exploit correlations between photons. The successful candidate will have a leading role in a Laboratory Directed Research and Development (LDRD) project spanning simulation, instrument development and experimental demonstration. The candidate will build Monte Carlo models of imaging systems, design and commission a prototype in a SLAC laboratory, and compare measured images with simulation to quantify the achievable reduction in dose. The project brings together scientists across LCLS, SSRL and SLAC's detector groups with external university partners, and is closely linked to a DOE X-ray quantum imaging program. The candidate is expected to have core interests in quantum or correlated imaging, physics simulations and experimental setup.

  

The candidate will be required to engage in and drive scientific research on low-dose correlated imaging, from simulation through to experimental demonstration. The dissemination of scientific outcomes through peer reviewed publications, as well as presentations at meetings/conferences, is expected. SLAC is committed to fostering a work environment that promotes inclusion, diversity, equity and accountability. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply; you do not need to meet all the Preferred Qualifications to be considered.

  

Note: The Research Associate role is a fixed term staff position. Appointment duration is **for 2- year fixed term**, with the possibility of extension. Assignment duration is contingent upon project needs and funding.

Applicants must provide evidence of either a recently completed PhD degree or confirmation of completion of the PhD degree requirements prior to starting the position. Applicants should also include a cover letter, a curriculum vitae which includes a list of publications, and names of three references for future letters of recommendation with the application.

**Your specific responsibilities include:**

Develop and demonstrate low-dose correlated imaging by:

* Building and running Monte Carlo radiation-transport simulations to optimize the imaging geometry, materials and detectors, and to establish the limits of the method
* Designing, assembling and commissioning a prototype imaging system, including mechanics, detectors and data-acquisition electronics

This approach enables novel access to modern structural and screening technologies used in industrial-scale drug discovery for the entire class of GPCRs. Septerna has an emerging pipeline of GPCR-targeted small molecule programs, many in the Endocrinology space, with potential for growth to target many GPCRs that have been undruggable and unexploited to date.

We are excited to expand our multidisciplinary team of individuals focused on creating revolutionary medicines to address the unmet needs of patients. At Septerna we strive to embrace diversity of thought, expertise, and background through collaboration.
